children: ICICI Securities research report on Fortis Healthcare

In litigation ongoing since 2018, the Delhi High Court on 31st Aug’26, accepted Daiichi’s demand for a forensic audit. S Ramanand Aiyar & Co will conduct the audit and examine all Fortis share and fund movements since 24 May’16, including the scrutiny of INR 46.66bn transferred to RHT (Religare Health Trust) and the Fortis-IHH-RHT Health transaction chain. Management refutes playing a role in the stake sale and change of control. The audit process may take 7-8 months to complete, and, as per management, it may not impact Fortis’ operations, expansion plans and financial performance.
The audit does not restrict IHH from infusing further capital (raising its stake to ~51% from 31%) in Fortis or the merger of Gleneagles. Retain BUY and TP of INR 1,075.
